posts.name: Debanjali
posts.cooked:
My specific doubt is on the topic: SCT exam access

My doubt is: So far, I have only received,

  1. The help video explaining how the SCT exam will work.

  2. The guidelines document.

  3. Reminder emails about completing the SCT examination.

However there’s still no mail regarding the g-meet link which some of my other peers have apparently received.

posts.name: Preethy Parthasarathy
posts.cooked: Same here. I have raised a ticket through support. I can add your email as well in the ticket, if you would like.

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
There is no problem because sometime due to technical glitch you can’t receive the Meeting link.
You have option to create a meet link by yourself and follow the further steps given in the demo video.
There is no problem if you do this because the meeting link is not something special it is just a common link for everyone so, you comfortably complete the procedure and in-case you didn’t receive you can use this alternative also.

posts.name: Debanjali
posts.cooked: So u can create one for yourself apparently & go ahead with the exam.

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
ya, this is non-proctored
Proctored Exam will be OPPE (which will conduct soon)
